Apple compilation blocker repair at `d849515b2a1f6048ed280e44e677f532a57d4f5f`.

The previous iPhone run fails production compilation at `CookieManager.ios.kt` because the native callback supplies a nullable cookie list; WebView executes **zero tests**. `cookies.orEmpty().filterIsInstance<NSHTTPCookie>()` repairs that nullable-list source error while keeping the native store and request matching logic.

Repaired Apple compilation/runtime cookie checks have not run. [Preserved run/limitations](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/d849515b2a1f6048ed280e44e677f532a57d4f5f/docs/development/checkpoint-ci-20261026.md). Native HTTP request-header comparison, secure/host-only/path/expiry/duplicate-name cases remain acceptance gates; no issue closure or runtime success is claimed.
